items.title: Al Tinney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: Jeff Meister — drums with Michael Sidisky. And he plays with us sometimes, with Advantage you know.

ctx.x: And so this organizational mind of mine, it’s sort of methodical. I like, you know like on my job I have a certain system that I use to play, which is — it’s not chaos but there’s no strictness to it. There’s no commitment to it you know. We get on the bandstand and I’ll start off an introduction or something — an interesting thing, a young man, his name was Meister — Jeff Meister — drums with Michael Sidisky. And he plays with us sometimes, with Advantage you know. When I need a substitute he comes in. And the…
